name: uptale
description: Create, edit and translate Uptale immersive training experiences from ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Give me the outline of my latest Uptale experience.
Add a three-question quiz to the first scene of my experience.

review.commerce_description: No purchase or payment happens in ChatGPT. Uptale is licensed to organizations under a separate contract.

positive.description: Lists the workspaces of the signed-in user.
positive.prompt: Which Uptale workspaces can I edit?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspaces of the reviewer account, including Uptale Review.

positive.description: Lists the experiences of a workspace named by the user.
positive.prompt: List the experiences in my Uptale Review workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Uptale Review workspace, then lists its experiences, including Warehouse safety induction.

positive.description: Reads the outline of an experience.
positive.prompt: Give me the outline of the Warehouse safety induction experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the scenes of the experience in order, with the number of tags in each.

positive.prompt: In my Uptale Review workspace, create an experience called Forklift basics with two scenes: Introduction and Loading bay.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Forklift basics experience, adds the two scenes and gives the link to open it in Uptale.

positive.description: Adds a quiz to an existing scene.
positive.prompt: Add a quiz to the first scene of Warehouse safety induction asking where the fire exit is, with three answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one quiz tag with the question and three answers in the first scene, and says which answer is marked correct.

negative.description: Answers a weather question without Uptale.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any Uptale tool.

negative.description: Writes a slide deck outline without Uptale.
negative.prompt: Write me a slide deck outline about workplace safety.
negative.expected_behavior: Writes the outline in the conversation without calling any Uptale tool.

negative.description: Answers a general knowledge question without Uptale.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between virtual reality and augmented reality?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without calling any Uptale tool.

publication.release_notes: First release: read, create and translate Uptale experiences, and upload media, from ChatGPT.
